cabin.title: За рычагами
cabin.subtitle: «Смена начинается»
cabin.prompt:
Photorealistic photo editing: place the person from image 1 into the base scene from image 3. Preserve their recognisable facial features, gender, hairstyle, skin tone and overall appearance. Match their natural body build from image 2.
Image 3 is the BASE photograph: the interior of a forestry forwarder cab seen from the front - the empty operator seat in the middle, both armrests with their joysticks, control screens at the edges, and beyond the glass a sunlit pine forest with stacks of cut logs. Keep this background, camera angle, framing, perspective and composition unchanged. The cab panels stay BLANK — no logos, no stickers, no brand marks on the machine itself; the only brand mark in the frame is the one on the guest's cap and jacket. SEAT the guest IN THE OPERATOR SEAT: they sit upright in the seat facing the camera, hands resting naturally on both joysticks, shoulders relaxed, a light confident smile. Frame them from the WAIST UP, large in the frame; the joysticks, the panel and the forest through the glass stay clearly visible around them.
CINEMATIC COLOUR GRADE like a professional editorial photo shoot: clean industrial daylight with gentle filmic contrast and slightly lifted blacks, saturated safety-yellow machine paint, warm true-to-life skin tones, soft highlight roll-off on metal and glass, subtle vignette, magazine look; no harsh shadows on the face, keep it softly and evenly lit.
FRAMING LOCK — CRITICAL: this is a THREE-QUARTER PORTRAIT. The bottom edge of the frame cuts the person between the hips and the upper thigh: show the head, shoulders, chest, arms and hips. NEVER show the full body, the knees, the lower legs, the feet or the shoes, and never step the camera back for a full-length shot. The person fills most of the frame height and reads large and close, with comfortable space above the head — a magazine cover crop.
BACKGROUND LOCK — CRITICAL: the background must be a FAITHFUL PIXEL-LEVEL COPY of image 3. Do NOT redraw, restyle, replace, re-imagine or 'improve' any object in the scene, and do not change their shapes, colours, lettering or positions. Every machine, sign and structure must look EXACTLY as in image 3 — the guest is the ONLY thing added or replaced. The cab interior must be copied EXACTLY from image 3 - the same seat, the same joysticks, the same panel and screens, the same windows and the same view outside; never redraw the cab into a different, generic or invented one.
The person is FULLY CLOTHED, wearing: {OUTFIT}.
FACE LOCK — CRITICAL: the face must match image 1 EXACTLY in shape and proportions — same face width, same jawline, same cheekbones, same chin shape, same nose, same eye spacing and same eyebrow shape. Do NOT widen, round, puff up, fatten, swell, slim, beautify, smooth away features, age or rejuvenate the face, and do not make it fuller or heavier than in image 1. The facial outline and jawline must stay crisp and clearly defined, never soft, blurred, swollen or inflated. The result must be recognisable as the SAME person at a glance.
EYES: both eyes symmetric, fully open, correct natural shape with defined eyelids, iris and pupil; never squinting, uneven or melted. MOUTH: relaxed natural lips resting gently together in a soft neutral expression — full natural human lip shape with one clean continuous outline, both upper and lower lip clearly visible, symmetric and evenly shaped, the mouth closed and at rest.
The ENTIRE image must read as a REAL DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPH, never a 3D render or illustration: authentic textures, natural photographic grain and micro-contrast. SHARPNESS: the FACE is the sharpest element of the whole photograph — tack-sharp eyes with crisp catchlights and clearly defined eyelashes, and lips with a precise clean outline. Ultra-realistic professional DSLR quality, sharp focus, natural skin texture, correct anatomy and seamless blending. Remove tattoos and blemishes. No nudity, no extra people; no text, watermarks or logos anywhere EXCEPT the specified prints on the workwear and helmet, no background changes, no blur, distortion, plastic skin, AI artifacts or cut-out appearance.
cabin.light: soft daylight coming through the cab glass from the front and sides, gentle indoor shade on the body, no direct sun on the face.
